description: Get the next step for verifying the user's identity and work permits on Himalayas (the verified badge): whether they are verified, and otherwise the Stripe Identity link (when verification is included, as on Plus or Max) or a US$5 checkout link. Use it when the user wants to get verified: when verification is included, this starts it (a Plus or Max member's included verification is then used for 30 days). A passport or national ID verifies identity and the work permit for that country; other IDs verify identity only. get_my_profile shows whether they are verified. The user opens each link and does the verification or payment on Stripe themselves. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.
name: get_verification_link
title: Get ID verification link
